title: Spectral Deflation for Factorization-Free Matrix Filtering in Muon and Semidefinite Programming
summary: GPU implementations of the Muon optimizer and of first-order semidefinite programming (SDP) solvers share one computational pattern: a matrix factorization is replaced by a fixed-depth polynomial filter applied after normalization. When a few dominant spectral components carry most of the input's scale, normalization pushes the remaining spectrum toward zero, where the filter is least accurate. We propose spectral deflation: estimate the dominant components, remove them, filter the normalized residual with the unchanged filter, and restore them. Deflation preserves the target matrix…
